title: What is checkmate?
body: Checkmate means the king is in check and there is no legal move to escape. The game ends immediately.

title: A checkmate position
body: Black is in check from the queen and has no legal escape squares.

title: A stalemate position
body: Black is not in check, but has no legal move. That makes it stalemate, not checkmate.

title: What is this position?
question: Look at the board. What is the result?
successText: Correct. Black is not in check, but cannot move.
errorText: Not quite. Check first whether the king is actually in check.

title: Click the trapped king
body: Click the black king in this stalemate position.
successText: Correct. That king has no legal moves.
errorText: Try again. Click the black king on h8.

title: Lesson recap
body: Checkmate wins. Stalemate draws. Always ask: is the king in check or just trapped?
